title: Marquis del Vasto to Charles V and the letter to "Garbino", 1527-28, BnF fr. 3022 nos. 6, 10, 20 (catalogue item 7)

plaintext.source: George Lasry's decryption (2023) with Satoshi Tomokiyo's edited text (2026), cryptiana GL.htm 'Gasto-Charles V Cipher 1'; copy in prior/BnF_fr3022_f26_decryption.txt. Some groups still marked '?'.

transcription.notes: Found already read by others; no work of this project on the text. The file is an edited plaintext (1,146 words, 47 carrying a '?', 19 of them a bare '?' for an unread group), not a sign transcription, so no cipher-token fraction is measured. Recorded as read in part (was 'read' until 22 Sept 2026) because the edited text still has queried words and garbled stretches and Tomokiyo asks for it to be completed.

plaintext.source: Lasry's 2026 preliminary letter-level decryption ('Gasto-Charles V Cipher 2', cryptiana GL.htm), prior/BnF_fr3022_f16_decryption.txt, with code groups and syllable signs identified here from context (n6_reading.md 18 Sept; n6_signs.tsv 22 Sept 2026).

transcription.source: Lasry's decryption kept as a sign-level token list (one token per cipher sign, his labels) in n6_signs.tsv; checked against the Gallica images (views 32-34) wherever a reading turns on the glyph; 5 signs he left out (the 'at quia' switch markers on f. 17r) added from the image.
transcription.notes: 1,680 tokens = Lasry's 1,675 for ff. 16v-17v ('_' and <plaintext> dropped) + 5 from the image; counted by n6_measure.py, which also checks the token stream against Lasry's file. _check_profile.py --measure does not apply (the file is a reading table, not a bare ciphertext).

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 3022 no. 20, ff. 44r-46v (views 86-91); 18th-c. copy Clair. 327 ff. 279-280

plaintext.source: Paolo Rosson, with Claude, 'The Venetian? cipher with superscript digits of 1528' (https://pangoleen.github.io/cipher-readings/centurione-1528.html, listed 6 Oct 2026; Cryptoole IT1520-1 marks it solved, Rosson and Lasry): key table of 779 values, found 14 Oct 2026. Applied to this project's transcription of f. 44r-46v it values 1,230 of 1,311 parsed groups (93.8%: sure, probable or null), 37 are guesses and 44 have no value; 1,046 (79.8%) lie in runs of six or more sure/probable values. Their own estimate: 86% of the cipher text in connected stretches, about 85% of tokens right, f. 46v weakest (66%). Not checked by a palaeographer.

transcription.source: Full-resolution Gallica scans of ff. 44r-46v; plus ~2,600 groups of Ranzo's signed letters in BnF fr. 2988 (n20/ranzo_c0*.txt) transcribed by subagents
transcription.notes: Sum of --measure over n20/f44r, f44v, f45r, f45v, f46r, f46v.txt with --skip '^\|' (155+73+316+171+366+240); includes one '·' separator and bracketed doubt marks. NOTES give 1,315 groups (546 types) after load.py drops those. 14 Oct 2026: Rosson's image check corrected 84 tokens by hypothesis, of which the images confirmed 76, and found that in fr. 2988 57 'g' are s and 63 't' are r (two hands); the corrections are applied in measure_rosson.py.

documents.shelfmark: BnF fr. 2988 ff. 9r-10v (views 17-20; DECODE R1894), signed Hieronimo Ranzo, Madrid, March 1528; copy fr. 20506 f. 136 (DECODE R4450)

plaintext.source: Rosson's key (see no20) applied to this transcription: 1,776 groups parsed; 1,727 (97.2%) valued sure, probable or null, 25 guesses, 24 without value; 1,654 (93.1%) in runs of six or more sure/probable values. The letter reads as Italian instructions about copying a cipher and addressing letters through Hieronimo Ranzo. Measured with measure_rosson.py.

transcription.source: Full-resolution Gallica scans of fr. 2988 ff. 9r-10v (views 17-20), transcribed by subagents (n20/ranzo_c017-c020.txt)
transcription.notes: Sum of --measure over ranzo_c017 to c020 (499+510+514+266 tokens, counting '/' separators and doubt marks). Rosson's check of the images corrected some g/t tokens (see no20).

system.summary: Nos. 6/10: Caesar-shifted substitution over a 21-letter alphabet with homophones and three-letter b-/c-/d- code groups; no. 20: Ranzo's code of initial letter plus a non-alphabetical number.
system.sibling_key: No. 6 shares Lasry's Cipher 2 key with no. 19 (ff. 40-43, 6 Nov 1527), used for code contexts. No. 20 shares its code with Ranzo's signed letters in fr. 2988 and fr. 3019 no. 27; no key found.
system.notes: No. 20 base lists per letter (a1-326 … z1-35) from the addition sheet (additione.json); numbering tested not alphabetical (n20/alphatest.py, z = -0.5 vs +6.5 on an alphabetical control), hence key_order random for no. 20. z-groups behave as nulls or punctuation.

prior_solution.where: cryptiana GL.htm: Lasry 2023 / Tomokiyo 2026 reading of no. 10; Lasry 2026 preliminary letter-level decryption of no. 6 (Cipher 2). Nothing for no. 20. Rosson (with Claude) 6 Oct 2026, centurione-1528 page: a key for Ranzo's code (no. 20 and fr. 2988 ff. 9-10), found 14 Oct 2026 by a Cryptoole alert, after this project had closed no. 20 as unread.

conditions.human_role: Project-level: obtained a DECODE login with privileges and passed its session cookie (from the browser developer tools) to the model, set up Claude Code with Fable 5.1 or Opus 5, and posed the problem with /goal; occasionally offered encouragement or chose which of the model-identified leads to pursue. No target-specific intervention recorded.
tools: word-substitution annealer with Kneser-Ney word-bigram Italian LM (n20/solve2.py)
annealers assuming alphabetical order (n20/solve.py, anchor.py, free.py)
sign-level reading file and measure (n6_signs.tsv, n6_measure.py)

solution.what: Fetched fr. 3022 (Gallica btv1b90601558) and identified the three catalogue pieces and folios.
Found no. 10 already solved by Lasry (2023) with Tomokiyo's edited text (2026), and Lasry's 2026 preliminary decryption of Cipher 2 covering no. 6 and no. 19.
Checked Lasry's no. 6 decryption against the f. 16v ciphertext (dʃfp = creo, nnbt = mas, qʃftxp = presto); identified no. 6 as del Vasto's own letter of early Dec 1527.

Identified about 40 b-/c-/d- code groups of no. 6 from context across nos. 6 and 19 (doz = Lautreque, deh = la Marca, dnb = dinero …) and made an edited reading (n6_reading.md); about 15 codes and some stretches open.
Transcribed no. 20 (1,315 groups) and ~2,600 groups of Ranzo's signed letters in fr. 2988; addition sheet transcribed (additione.json).
No. 20 code is initial letter + number, the number running in alphabetical order within each letter (solve.py, anchor.py).
Word annealer (solve2.py) on a held-out 3,900-word Castiglione control encoded the same way: ~46 % token, ~9 % type accuracy.
solve2.py on no. 20 + Ranzo: a stable function-word skeleton (che, il, per, non …) across six restarts; no content words.

Sought cribs: Clair. 327 and Clair. 314 copies (undeciphered), fr. 2988 other cipher pieces (a different French cipher), fr. 3019 no. 27 Ranzo letter (no decipherment), no duplicate text between no. 20 and Ranzo letters.
DECODE R1894 (catalogue 170) identified as the fr. 2988 Ranzo letter already transcribed; no key or decipherment on the record.

Kept Lasry's no. 6 decryption as a sign-level token list with a reading and status per token run (n6_signs.tsv); n6_measure.py checks the stream against Lasry's file and counts. Added the 5 'at quia' signs he left in <plaintext>.
First measurement of no. 6: Lasry's key alone 1,555/1,680 = 92.6%; with the 18 Sept code identifications 1,595/1,680 = 94.9%. The 18 Sept verdict 'read' had been unmeasured.

Checked the syllable-code signs on views 32-34 where a reading turned on the glyph: Lasry's two-per-syllable labels merge different signs. boz = esto (not fin), bab = mas, bar = tan, bop = como, bopt = ellos (Lasry 'con s'), bie = el (Lasry 'al'), bis = de, bep = es or en; <37> at 17va.11 is r.

Context readings (grade I): da = otro (not liga; nosotros, 'otro fruto'), dop = tiempo (not invierno), dab = tiene(n), <37> = final(mente), stop sign; 'at' and 'quia' identified as clear/cipher switch markers at every boundary in nos. 6 and 19.

Scanned no. 19 ff. 41r-41v on the images for the open groups; bet = dello from 'el poco cuidado que [bet] he' (f. 41v) fits no. 6 'exercito [bet]s tan pujante'. ff. 41-43 not transcribed in full; no other open group found.
Re-measured no. 6: 1,646/1,680 = 98.0% read; 11 nomenclator tokens (10 types: dnh, bnq, rar, car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+, der at 17va.2) and 23 other tokens in 9 short stretches open.

Statistical validation (docs/_validate.py): 1631 tokens, 65 types, es-golden-age order 4: reading -1.931 per letter; random keys -4.675 (z 7.3); key annealed onto shuffled ciphertext best -3.049 (mean -3.084, z 39.4); annealer on the real text -1.921. Verdict: pass.

A Cryptoole alert (IT1520-1, solved 6 Oct 2026 by Paolo Rosson and George Lasry) led to Rosson's page and files (key/table.tsv, reading/islands.md, decode.py). Their reading uses this project's transcription for fr. 3022 no. 20 and fr. 2988, and a new transcription of the duplicate fr. 3019 ff. 73-74. No. 20 was not unread for lack of a key after all.

Applied Rosson's 779-value key (with his transcription corrections) to n20/f44r-f46v and ranzo_c006-c020. Groups with a value (sure, probable, null): no. 20 93.8%, R1894 (c017-c020) 97.2%; in runs of six or more sure/probable values: no. 20 79.8%, R1894 93.1%. Spot check: c017 and c020 decode as coherent 1528 Italian. Below the 95% bar on the connected-stretch measure; 84 groups of 3,903 have no value. Did not rerun their blind controls.

validation.notes: claimed per-occurrence score -1.888; polyphony 0.04; 49 unread tokens left out; annealer on the real text from random keys reached -1.921

outcome.method_basis: No. 6 was read with Lasry's 2026 preliminary decryption and key for 'Gasto-Charles V Cipher 2' (cryptiana GL.htm), extended with about 40 code groups from context and glyph checks (92.6% to 98.0%); no. 10 is Lasry and Tomokiyo's reading, not reworked; no. 20 (Ranzo to Garbino) was not solved.
outcome.fraction_read_source: Nos. 6 and 20 (no. 10 excluded: read by others, not reworked). No. 6: 1,646 of 1,680 cipher tokens read (n6_signs.tsv via n6_measure.py, 98.0%); no. 20: 0 of 1,321 groups (n20/f44r-f46v.txt). (1,646)/(1,680+1,321) = 0.5485. No. 6 alone meets the 95% bar; no. 20 is blocked (no key material).

gaps.item: No. 6 code groups dnh, bnq, rar (x2), car, cny, bny, beb, bnc, ge+, der at 17va.2 (11 tokens)
gaps.detail: One or two contexts each, none fixing a value (rar Florencia or Luca; ge+ perhaps a stop). More contexts in no. 19 ff. 41-43, not transcribed in full.

gaps.item: No. 6 nine short stretches (23 tokens): 'y y por [mq]', 'es [en de las los]', '[es de] otro exercito', 'servira [que de con]', 'ira [que l] camino', '[der de] pais', 'en [cnt] parte', 'esperar [es]', 'apuntamiento [es]'
gaps.detail: Signs transcribed but the syllable-sign values do not make sense there; Lasry's labels probably merge different glyphs. Needs glyph-level retranscription.

gaps.item: No. 10: 47 queried words in Lasry/Tomokiyo's edited text
gaps.detail: Found read by others, not reworked, no sign transcription to measure.

gaps.item: No. 20 and R1894 (fr. 2988 ff. 9-10): 84 groups without a value and 76 guesses in 3,903 parsed groups
gaps.detail: Rosson's key leaves 86 groups unvalued by his count; stems and numbers 6-9 spelling signs remain. Needs a comparison of their readings with the images, and the other Ranzo letters (fr. 2988 ff. 2r-v, fr. 3019 f. 73 duplicate) transcribed.

outcome.notes: Per document: no. 6 read (98.0% measured, 22 Sept 2026; was 'read' unmeasured on 18 Sept); no. 10 read in part by Lasry/Tomokiyo, not measured; no. 20 not read. The target stays read in part because no. 20 is unread. Grades: 34 values inferred from context (24 code groups, 8 syllable signs, 2 switch markers); Lasry's letter key is taken as it stands. NOTES.md has '## Remaining gaps' and '## Escalation'. 14 Oct 2026: no. 20 is no longer unread: Rosson's key (6 Oct 2026) reads it in part; see parts. fraction_read still counts only this project's own reading (no. 6).
